transcript.t: Rick, you look worried. What happened?
I cannot find my notebook. I think I left it at the mall.
Try to recall. Where did you go first?
To start with, I went to the bookshop. Then I had lunch with Bob.
Did you take the notebook out at lunch?
Yes! I was writing my homework. I probably left it on the table.
Let's go back to the restaurant. Maybe someone kept it for you.
Good idea. Next time I will put my name and address inside.
